AdmissionCode.description: The shared admission lock refused because capacity is held by another admission.
AdmissionCode.title: AdmissionCode

AgentEvidenceCode.description:
Optional agent evidence that was dropped so the mandatory report is kept.

An agent report carries a mandatory core (identity, lease, capacity, outcome)
and optional evidence (NICs, the NAS route, fabric details, readings,
progress, diagnostics). Invalid optional evidence is never a reason to refuse
the core: the evidence is dropped and one of these words names what was lost,
on the agent that dropped it and on the Controller that received it.
AgentEvidenceCode.title: AgentEvidenceCode

ApiReasoningAlwaysOn.description: No request turns reasoning off; the checkpoint may still skip it on a turn.
ApiReasoningAlwaysOn.title: ApiReasoningAlwaysOn

ApiReasoningEffortLevels.description:
The request names one of ``levels`` at ``key``; another value may be refused.

``default`` is the level in force when the request names none. Only the
names a client chooses from are listed: an engine's own numeric scale behind
them (an integer or float alias) is not.
ApiReasoningEffortLevels.title: ApiReasoningEffortLevels

ApiReasoningEffortText.description:
The route takes any string at ``key`` (the template writes it into the prompt).

``default`` is the text in force when the request sets none; ``null`` when
then no effort is written and the checkpoint decides.
ApiReasoningEffortText.title: ApiReasoningEffortText

ApiReasoningSwitch.description:
Thinking can be turned on and off per request.

``keys`` are the alternative request keys the route reads (any one works);
``default`` is what the route does when the request says nothing, and
``model`` when the checkpoint decides.
ApiReasoningSwitch.title: ApiReasoningSwitch

ApiRemainingContext.description: No server default: the request may use what the context still holds.
ApiRemainingContext.title: ApiRemainingContext

ApiTokenArgument.description:
The server default is the value of this runtime argument.

The number is never copied here: it is read from the recipe's arguments (as
the option choice in force sets them), so it cannot drift from the launch.
ApiTokenArgument.title: ApiTokenArgument

ApiTokenSetting.description: Bound to the recipe setting of the same name, as ``RecipeRuntimeArgument``.
ApiTokenSetting.title: ApiTokenSetting

ApiToolsSupported.description:
Function calling works.

``tool_choice`` lists the choices the route enforces. ``none`` is always
honoured, so it is implied and never listed. An empty list means non-auto
choices are accepted but not enforced (a prompt nudge, or ignored). An
unlisted value may be refused (HTTP 400).
ApiToolsSupported.title: ApiToolsSupported

ArtifactLifecycleCode.description: Why an artifact (model file, image archive, blob) cannot be removed, referenced or changed right now.
ArtifactLifecycleCode.title: ArtifactLifecycleCode

AudioSpeechApi.description:
A route serving ``POST /v1/audio/speech``: text in, audio bytes out.

``voices`` are the values of OpenAI's ``voice`` parameter; the first is the
route's health-check voice. ``instructions`` and ``speed`` say whether the
engine honours those OpenAI parameters. ``max_input_chars`` bounds ``input``.
AudioSpeechApi.title: AudioSpeechApi

AudioTranscriptionApi.description:
A route serving ``POST /v1/audio/transcriptions``: one audio upload in.

The input is audio by mode, so the block has no modalities or token limits.
``max_file_bytes`` and ``max_audio_seconds`` are the engine's own upload and
decode limits (``null``: the engine states no duration limit); ``languages``
are the ISO 639-1 values of OpenAI's ``language`` parameter the engine
accepts. ``prompt`` and ``temperature`` say whether the engine honours those
OpenAI parameters; no ``timestamp_granularities`` means none are offered.
AudioTranscriptionApi.title: AudioTranscriptionApi

BlockingOperation.description: The operation a wait is behind, so a reader can follow it.
BlockingOperation.title: BlockingOperation

CacheReferenceReason.description: What keeps a cached artifact from being removed.
CacheReferenceReason.title: CacheReferenceReason

CatalogCode.description: Refusals of the recipe catalog and the recipe library documents.
CatalogCode.title: CatalogCode

CatalogSyncCode.description: Catalog synchronisation refusals and per-item problems.
CatalogSyncCode.title: CatalogSyncCode

ClusterMappingCode.description: Refusals of a cluster mapping (recipe-to-Spark assignment) request.
ClusterMappingCode.title: ClusterMappingCode

ControllerErrorCode.description: Generic Controller request and fleet-operation problem codes.
ControllerErrorCode.title: ControllerErrorCode

DecisionApi.description: A route serving ``POST /v1/systemone``; it has no chat-shaped facts.
DecisionApi.title: DecisionApi

DistributionCode.description: Why a distribution assignment object cannot be served to a Spark.
DistributionCode.title: DistributionCode

FailureCode.description: Closed codes of a definite failed outcome reported by the agent.
FailureCode.title: FailureCode

GitHubLfsSource.description:
Git LFS objects at one commit of a canonical public GitHub repository.

Every model file is one LFS object: its ``sha256`` is the LFS oid, its
``size_bytes`` the LFS size, and its ``path`` the file's path in the
repository at ``revision`` (the full commit SHA). The bytes are fetched by
oid and verified at ingress; the commit and path record where the binding
of path to oid was read.
GitHubLfsSource.title: GitHubLfsSource

GitHubReleaseAsset.description: One GitHub release asset selected for an existing model file.
GitHubReleaseAsset.title: GitHubReleaseAsset

GitHubReleaseSource.description: An exact asset from one release in a canonical GitHub repository.
GitHubReleaseSource.title: GitHubReleaseSource

HelperErrorCode.description:
Every code the privileged helper, or the agent speaking about it, names as an error.

The helper builds its rejection from a member; the agent reads a reply code
through the enum, so a word outside it is a malformed rejection, never a code
the agent invents or forwards.  ``runtime_helper_*`` is the spelling of an
agent-side cause in failure evidence.
HelperErrorCode.title: HelperErrorCode

HelperOperationCode.description: Stable diagnostic codes returned by the privileged operation executor.
HelperOperationCode.title: HelperOperationCode

IdentityConflict.description:
The two identities a conflict names, typed so evidence keeps them whole.

``authoritative`` is ``None`` when the owner holds no such identity.
IdentityConflict.title: IdentityConflict

ImageStoreCode.description: Refusals and damage found by the Controller OCI image store.
ImageStoreCode.title: ImageStoreCode

InstallAdmissionCode.description: Why an installation is not admitted (or is waiting) on a Spark.
InstallAdmissionCode.title: InstallAdmissionCode

InstallDegradedReason.description: Why an installation is shown partial in the fleet projection.
InstallDegradedReason.title: InstallDegradedReason

InvalidRequestReason.description: Closed reason codes of an invalid request (submit-time input validation).
InvalidRequestReason.title: InvalidRequestReason

LibraryAssessmentCode.description: Why a library entry is not assessed runnable on the current fleet.
LibraryAssessmentCode.title: LibraryAssessmentCode

LibraryLocalProgress.description: Observable progress for a Controller-local preparation operation.
LibraryLocalProgress.title: LibraryLocalProgress

LibraryLocalState.description: Controller cache and Spark-local runtime evidence kept separate.
LibraryLocalState.title: LibraryLocalState

LibraryProjectionCode.description: Reasons the library projection truncates what it lists.
LibraryProjectionCode.title: LibraryProjectionCode

LibraryResourceProjection.description:
Declared resource facts; unknown values remain null.

``memory_bytes`` is the steady peak. ``load_peak_bytes`` and
``minimum_swap_bytes`` are the recipe's declared values, never derived.
LibraryResourceProjection.title: LibraryResourceProjection

MemoryUsageUncertainty.description: Fresh aggregate capacity lacks per-run resident usage evidence.
MemoryUsageUncertainty.title: MemoryUsageUncertainty

ModelAccessReason.description: Visible model access dependencies, shared by wait and recovery.
ModelAccessReason.title: ModelAccessReason

ModelCacheBlockerCode.description: Why a model download plan is blocked or waiting.
ModelCacheBlockerCode.title: ModelCacheBlockerCode

ModelCacheCode.description: Model cache resolution, storage, removal and operation problems.
ModelCacheCode.title: ModelCacheCode

ModelCacheFailureCode.description: Public cache failure semantics preserved in availability projections.
ModelCacheFailureCode.title: ModelCacheFailureCode

ModelDefinition.description: One exact model version and variant, including its complete manifest.
ModelDefinition.title: ModelDefinition

ModelFile.description:
One entry in the complete immutable model file manifest.

``sha256`` and ``size_bytes`` always describe the whole installed file.
When the source publishes the file only as split parts, ``parts`` lists
them in joining order (byte concatenation yields the file). Omitted means
the source publishes the file whole, so the same bytes have the same
identity whether the source splits them or not.
ModelFile.title: ModelFile

ModelFilePart.description:
One published piece of a file the source can only host split.

A part is a transport detail: it exists only at the source (for example a
Hugging Face repository that caps files at 50 GB publishes
``model.safetensors.part00``). It is never installed.
ModelFilePart.title: ModelFilePart

ModelIdentity.description: The logical model, exact version, and selected variant.
ModelIdentity.title: ModelIdentity

ModelLineage.description:
Where a Model sits in the catalog: Family, then Line, then Model release.

``family``, ``line`` and ``model`` are slugs a :class:`FamilyDisplay` names
(a Line is unique within its Family, a Model within its Line).
``generation`` and ``publisher`` are facets across Lines.
ModelLineage.title: ModelLineage

NodeOfflineReason.description: Why a node is shown offline in the fleet projection.
NodeOfflineReason.title: NodeOfflineReason

OperationBlocker.description: One reason an operation is waiting or blocked, with the Sparks it concerns.
OperationBlocker.title: OperationBlocker

OperationFailureCode.description: Error codes of a stored operation failure evidence record.
OperationFailureCode.title: OperationFailureCode

PrebuiltImage.description: The CI-built runtime image of exactly this recipe revision.
PrebuiltImage.title: PrebuiltImage

PrebuiltImageCode.description: Why a prebuilt runtime image is, or is not, used.
PrebuiltImageCode.title: PrebuiltImageCode

ProfileReasonCode.description: Reasons a fleet profile cannot be applied or is waiting.
ProfileReasonCode.title: ProfileReasonCode

ProjectionCode.description: Warnings and attention items of the fleet and library projections.
ProjectionCode.title: ProjectionCode

QualificationUnverifiedReason.title: QualificationUnverifiedReason

RecipeAlternative.description: One other recipe serving the same model, for a one-line comparison.
RecipeAlternative.title: RecipeAlternative

RecipeApiOptionChoice.description: The complete block that applies when ``option`` is set to ``value``.
RecipeApiOptionChoice.title: RecipeApiOptionChoice

RecipeBuildCode.description: Recipe image build planning and recording problems.
RecipeBuildCode.title: RecipeBuildCode

RecipeDefinition.description: The sole public recipe authoring contract.
RecipeDefinition.title: RecipeDefinition

RecipeExecution.description: The platform builds every recipe image from its pinned base and context.
RecipeExecution.title: RecipeExecution

RecipeImageCode.description: Runtime image availability, preparation and cache-removal problems.
RecipeImageCode.title: RecipeImageCode

RecipeJobServingRequest.description: A job check stages its fixture as the input when the interface has one.
RecipeJobServingRequest.title: RecipeJobServingRequest

RecipeMemoryResources.description: Unified (DGX Spark) memory one role needs.
RecipeMemoryResources.title: RecipeMemoryResources

RecipeMultipartServingRequest.description: ``POST /v1/audio/transcriptions``: form fields plus one staged audio file.
RecipeMultipartServingRequest.title: RecipeMultipartServingRequest

RecipeOption.description:
A recipe-declared setting with a fixed set of named values.

Users pick one of the enumerated choices; there are no free-form values.
Exactly one choice is the default and applies whenever nothing is chosen.
RecipeOption.title: RecipeOption

RecipeOptionChoice.description:
One named value of an option, with the runtime changes it selects.

``args`` replace a base runtime argument of the same name in place, or are
appended after the base arguments; ``env`` does the same for environment
variables. Both go through the checks of ``runtime.arguments`` and
``runtime.environment``, and the platform applies its own security, mount
and port rules to the merged result.
RecipeOptionChoice.title: RecipeOptionChoice

RecipePackageCode.description: Recipe package download and verification problems.
RecipePackageCode.title: RecipePackageCode

RecipeRelease.description:
The version this recipe runs.

When the upstream project publishes versions, this is the upstream version
and its release date (for example ``1.6`` released 2026-09-17). A recipe
whose upstream has no versions carries its own semantic version instead.
The recipe library's own version follows the contract, not recipe content.
RecipeRelease.title: RecipeRelease

value.description: A literal process value; null is reserved for the setting-bound placeholder.

RecipeTopology.description:
Roles and their start order; everything else follows from node_count.

One node runs alone. More nodes share one connected fabric: losing a rank
withdraws the endpoint, recovery restarts the workers and then the
entrypoint, and stopping always starts with the endpoint owner.
RecipeTopology.title: RecipeTopology

ReconcileCode.description: Why an installation reconcile is blocked.
ReconcileCode.title: ReconcileCode

ResourceBlockerCode.description:
The capacity-fit codes the resource planner gives a node that cannot fit.

``insufficient`` is the family prefix a run admission maps onto
``run.insufficient_memory``; the planner itself names the exact
``insufficient_capacity*`` member.  Those are waits: a claim, a stop or a
fresh inventory can free the memory.  ``demand_exceeds_capacity`` is not in
that family: nothing the platform holds or plans to release can make the
demand fit the Spark (or one load's own assignments fit beside each other),
so the same request fails the same way and ends on its first occurrence.
``insufficient_swap`` is a wait too: the load phase's rise above the
steady demand needs more usable swap than the Spark has free now (another
load still starting holds it, or the swap setting is too small).
ResourceBlockerCode.title: ResourceBlockerCode

ResourceDemandEvidence.description: The evidence terms used for one selected rank's memory fit.
ResourceDemandEvidence.title: ResourceDemandEvidence

ResourcePlanningCode.description: Resource planning (memory, disk, parallelism) refusals and unknowns.
ResourcePlanningCode.title: ResourcePlanningCode

ResourceTerm.description: The effective settings whose capacity cost the resource planner derives.
ResourceTerm.title: ResourceTerm

ResourceTermProblem.description: What is wrong with the evidence for one resource term.
ResourceTermProblem.title: ResourceTermProblem

RunAdmissionCode.description:
The typed codes a run admission names for a refusal, blocker or wait.

``capacity_busy`` is lock contention only.  Every other reason an admission
must wait or is refused carries its own member, so a waiting operation shows
the real cause.  The retryable blockers (a plan that may become admissible
by itself) are a subset the Controller derives from these members.
RunAdmissionCode.title: RunAdmissionCode

RunDegradedReason.description: Why a run is shown degraded in the fleet projection.
RunDegradedReason.title: RunDegradedReason

RunMemoryResidualRange.description: Possible remaining bytes for one exact active run reservation.
RunMemoryResidualRange.title: RunMemoryResidualRange

RuntimeImageCode.description: Runtime image preparation, receipt and registry problems.
RuntimeImageCode.title: RuntimeImageCode

RuntimePreflightFindingCode.description:
Why one runtime preflight capability passed, failed or stayed unknown, as the agent reports it.

The agent builds every finding from a member; the Controller reads a code an
older agent sent as free text through :func:`adopt_preflight_finding_code`.
RuntimePreflightFindingCode.title: RuntimePreflightFindingCode

SecurityRefusalReason.description:
Closed reason codes of a security refusal: a real security boundary.

Authentication and authorization, identity and certificate expiry, node
revocation, enrollment, signed package metadata, host-helper authority,
tombstone fencing, credential denial and the digest-bound destructive-effect
checks of Run/Switch.  ``failure_classification`` derives its code set from
this enum, so the Controller and the contract cannot disagree.
SecurityRefusalReason.title: SecurityRefusalReason

SourcePolicyCode.description: Findings of the build source policy (Dockerfile and Compose rules).
SourcePolicyCode.title: SourcePolicyCode

SparkGroup.description: A complete, rank-labelled Spark group selected by the operator.
SparkGroup.title: SparkGroup

StopPlanCode.description: Why a stop plan is stale or cannot be taken.
StopPlanCode.title: StopPlanCode

StorageDemandCode.description: Storage demand outcomes of an admission.
StorageDemandCode.title: StorageDemandCode

StorageReliefEvidence.description: Free space and the collector's reclaim estimate for one node's demand.
StorageReliefEvidence.title: StorageReliefEvidence

SupersedeCode.description: Why a fleet profile application was superseded by newer intent.
SupersedeCode.title: SupersedeCode

SwapShortfallEvidence.description: The swap numbers behind one load's wait for swap, computed once at admission.
SwapShortfallEvidence.title: SwapShortfallEvidence

UninstallPlanCode.description: Why an uninstall plan is blocked or incomplete.
UninstallPlanCode.title: UninstallPlanCode

WaitReason.description:
Typed reasons for work awaiting execution or confirmation.

A queued order names its dependency; an executor reports the fact it could
not establish with an unknown outcome. Free text is for people; the
Controller decides on this code.
WaitReason.title: WaitReason
